data.exact_reserve_text: The change in claims outstanding includes the impact of release of net reserves for claims incurred on the prior years of GBP 15.9m (2023: strengthening of GBP 80.4m). These net reserve movements are stated net of the protection provided by the LPT.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Provides Group adverse development cover ($450m) on 2019 and prior accident years and transfers handling/responsibility for 2019 and prior gross claims; cedes surpluses on 2019 and prior and therefore reduces net reserve volatility for those years.

named_events.loss_description: Exposures reviewed; identified impacted policyholders and potential claims; reasonable provision for identified claims made; further claims possible.
Exposures from conflict in the Middle East are not expected to be material for the Syndicate.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2024 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 1,429.236m. During 2024 there was a gross prior-year reserve movement of a release of GBP 78.675m, driven by favourable claims development and materially affected by the Group's Enstar LPT reinsurance protection (which covers 2019 and prior). Net prior-year reserves released were GBP 15.9m (stated net of the LPT protection).
raw_causal_phrases: release of net reserves for claims incurred on the prior years of GBP 15.9m (2023: strengthening of GBP 80.4m).
These net reserve movements are stated net of the protection provided by the LPT.
The execution of a LPT with Enstar during 2022 has provided additional protection in terms of the reserves for all 2019 and prior years of claims.
Exposures relating to the Russia and Ukraine conflict have been reviewed and Aspen has identified impacted policy holders and potential claims, and examined received claims.
As with the rest of the industry, the Syndicate has assessed the impacts of both economic and social inflation on the reserve adequacy of its liabilities.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves and prior-year movement are taken from the Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding comparative) and the Technical Provisions reconciliation respectively (both presented in GBP 000). Prior-year development used is the GROSS figure from the 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' row (-GBP 78,675k). The narrative sentences quoted describe NET reserve movements; the gross movement is taken from the detailed table per extraction rules. No per-line-of-business prior-year reserve movements are disclosed, so lob_movements is empty. All monetary figures converted from GBP 000 to millions by dividing by 1,000.
